scientific_contract.marginal_covariance: diag(v+a)+b*Z*Ztranspose; effect and trial components nonnegative
scientific_contract.test: residual Student-t df=k-rank(X); pool k-1; two-sided p
scientific_contract.moderator: joint complete-cohort dummy-design REML; Wald F all nonreference coefficients/(p-1), numerator p-1, denominator k-p; predicted category CIs same residual df
scientific_contract.heterogeneity: Q using sampling-only inverse variance; Q_df=k-p; Q_p chi-square; Q-based I2 and variance-component I2 retained separately
scientific_contract.row_CI: g +/-1.96sqrt(v), row GLS weights from Minv1/sum for primary intercept
scientific_contract.identifiability: When every retained trial has one effect, Z*Ztranspose=I: components unidentifiable; set b=0 and estimate total a, identical marginal model. For one effect, a=b=0, no residual REML/t inference; report unavailable CI, do not invent significance. Independent representative may a=0,b=total; compare total/objective/pool rather than separate components when component_identifiable=false.
scientific_contract.optimizer: Primary full-matrix implementation uses analytic REML gradient, fixed starts plus both zero-component boundaries and zero corner, bounded search U=max(1,100*population variance of y); record all candidate/failed optimization paths. Independent block auditor uses its own optimizer and exact equivalent model. Boundary/identifiability conventions are public contract, not shared implementation.
scientific_contract.fit_convergence: Selected fit finite and projected gradient <=1e-5, component upper bound never active within1e-7; singular designs/failed fit retained and operational failure
scientific_contract.audit_tolerances: canonical fit g/SE/CIs/p/Q/I2/weights 1e-7 relative with scale max(1,abs(main),abs(audit)); optimized a/b or identifiable total and nll 1e-6; raw strings/scalars exact. Independent algorithm path/candidates need not byte-match.

independence: Neither implementation imports or reads the other mathematical code. Both may read this public contract and original source methods/targets only.

probe_geometry.Jacobian_fit_records: separate +/-h derivative fits; IDs Jacobian_%02d_minus/plus; source coordinate order, minus then plus; not fixed-e probes
probe_geometry.radius_domain: ONLY registered fixed-e probes; +/-h fits retained as derivative fits but not nonlinear-radius probes
probe_geometry.duplicates: retain every point/corner even identical; no deduplication
